# {{ company.name }} — full reference

> {{ company.name }} is {{ company.slogan | downcase }} based in {{ company.locality }}, {{ company.region }}, USA. It designs, assembles, and supports aviation headset adapters that connect general aviation (GA) pilot headsets to computers and tablets for flight simulation, a PCB for wiring headset jacks into real aircraft panels, and a free desktop app (USB2x Toolbar) for sidetone and VOX. Summary version: {{ "/llms.txt" | absolute_url }}

### 9er Systems USB2x Toolbar (free app)

Free desktop app for the USB2GA and USB2Lemo adapters.

- Features: one-click sidetone on/off; Smart VOX (sidetone follows your voice, with adjustable squelch); sidetone volume (Windows); separate microphone and speaker levels
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10 / 11
- Current version: {{ site.data.toolbar.version }}
- Price: free
- Download page: {{ "/downloads/toolbar/" | absolute_url }}
- Microsoft Store: {{ site.data.toolbar.windows.store_url }}
- Release notes: {{ "/downloads/toolbar/changelog/" | absolute_url }}
- Note: adapters sold before May 1, 2026 may not be compatible with sidetone support.
